method: Exact UI labels found in upstream source Markdown and page titles, matched to non-fuzzy non-empty msgstr entries in each product locale. Framework locale terms are inherited by Frappe apps; product locales override them. Existing reviewed terms are retained.

curated_terms.basis: The current ERPNext locale translates the singular label Price List as لیست قیمت; this plural page title is curated for natural Persian wording.

These are document UI labels whose upstream Helpdesk Persian locale entries have empty msgstr values. The Persian documentation uses the reviewed local terms; code spans and technical identifiers remain protected.
